title: G5: Don't automatically un-pair on phones that can't automatically re-pair
symptom: On phones that require user intervention to pair with a Bluetooth device, the old and new G5 collectors can automatically un-pair from the G5 to resolve a connection problem. This makes things worse because the phone cannot re-pair automatically, so xDrip won't get any data until the user manually intervenes.
cause: The collectors automatically un-pair on phones that cannot automatically re-pair, which is problematic.
fix: The issue was resolved in the nightly build, as confirmed by the user: 'it's working as expected -- far fewer instances where I have to manually repair because OB1 unpaired automatically.'
evidence_quote: Yup, it's working as expected -- far fewer instances where I have to manually repair because OB1 unpaired automatically.
